facts.value: Camera eye, interest and up state feed look-at view construction. Projection parameters and rectangle bounds feed GX projection, viewport and scissor setup. Activation clears the deferred Z list, records current and selects a render-pass setup; EndCurrent calls Z-list sort then display. The optional proj_mtx allocation caches the inverse of view_mtx.

facts.value: Activation rejects null, records current before render setup, and refreshes view only after successful setup. View regeneration requires camera mask 2 clear and view/WObj dirty state. Rebuilding clears view dirty indicators and sets inverse dirty bit 31. The Direct inverse accessor does not refresh view; it allocates/inverts only under bit 31 and clears that bit without checking inversion success.
